Criterion: Verify that the air vehicle system is equipped with breathing and eye protection equipment, fire-fighting equipment, and fire extinguishers appropriate for the expected use. Standard: If required, the air vehicle system is equipped with breathing and eye protection equipment to protect the crew from the effects of smoke, carbon dioxide or other harmful gases, or an oxygen deficient environment. Crewmembers are protected from these effects while combating fires within the control station. If required, fire extinguishers and other fire fighting equipment are conveniently located and readily accessible by the crew (see also 8.2, 8.4, and section 14). Method of Compliance: Inspection of operator/crew equipment provisions and the air vehicle system configuration verifies availability and accessibility of fire protection equipment. Inspections, analyses, and demonstrations verify that normal and emergency operations can be safely accomplished. References: JSSG-2001 JSSG-2010 JSSG-2010-9: 3.9.3 MIL-HDBK-516: 8.2, 8.4 and section 14 14 CFR 25.851, 29.851
